description: Steamcommunity 302 - local reverse proxy (hosts / DNS redirect / CDN optimization) improving Steam community, store and download access.
notes: Windows Defender may flag this as PUA (hosts modification); manually allow steamcommunity_302.exe / steamcommunity_302.caddy / steamcommunity_302.cli.exe if so.
Fully exit 302 first (stop service in Settings, then quit from tray) before scoop update/uninstall - running files are locked and Scoop silently skips.
302 has built-in auto update on Windows; prefer 'scoop update' to keep the install managed, and disable in-app auto update if the option exists.

Config, certificates and hosts live outside the app dir (%ProgramData%\Steamcommunity_302, %LocalAppData%\S302) and survive uninstall; follow the author's full-uninstall steps on the homepage when removing everything.
